question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Emma, and Claire gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Finally, Alice and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Emma
(C) Ivanhoe
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Walden, Emma, Ivanhoe)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (Walden, Ivanhoe, Emma)
2. Alice and Claire swap: (Emma, Ivanhoe, Walden)
3. Alice and Bob swap: (Ivanhoe, Emma, Walden)
Bob has Emma, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
